top.product: Connect Secure, Policy Secure, and Neurons
top.name: Ivanti Connect Secure, Policy Secure, and Neurons Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
top.description: Ivanti Connect Secure (ICS, formerly known as Pulse Connect Secure), Ivanti Policy Secure, and Ivanti Neurons contain a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability in the SAML component that allows an attacker to access certain restricted resources without authentication.

top.name: Oracle Corporation WebLogic Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
top.description: Oracle Corporation WebLogic Server contains a vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

top.name: Oracle WebLogic Server, Injection
top.description: Injection vulnerability in the Oracle WebLogic Server component of Oracle Fusion Middleware (subcomponent: Web Services).

top.name: Apache Log4j2 Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
top.description: Apache Log4j2 contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability due to the incomplete fix of CVE-2021-44228, where the Thread Context Lookup Pattern is vulnerable to remote code execution in certain non-default configurations.

top.name: Atlassian Confluence Server Pre-Authorization Arbitrary File Read Vulnerability
top.description: Affected versions of Atlassian Confluence Server allow remote attackers to view restricted resources via a pre-authorization arbitrary file read vulnerability in the /s/ endpoint.

top.name: Dasan GPON Routers Command Injection Vulnerability
top.description: Dasan GPON Routers contain an authentication bypass vulnerability. When combined with CVE-2018-10561, exploitation can allow an attacker to perform remote code execution.

top.name: Laravel Ignition File Upload Vulnerability
top.description: Laravel Ignition contains a file upload vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to execute malicious code due to insecure usage of file_get_contents() and file_put_contents().

top.name: Citrix NetScaler ADC and Gateway Out-of-Bounds Read Vulnerability
top.description: Citrix NetScaler ADC and Gateway contain an out-of-bounds read vulnerability due to insufficient input validation. This vulnerability can lead to memory overread when the NetScaler is configured as a Gateway (VPN virtual server, ICA Proxy, CVPN, RDP Proxy) OR AAA virtual server.

top.name: SonicWall SMA 100 Appliances Stack-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
top.description: SonicWall SMA 100 devies are vulnerable to an unauthenticated stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability where exploitation can result in code execution.

top.name: Microsoft SMBv3 Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
top.description: A remote code execution vulnerability exists in the way that the Microsoft Server Message Block 3.1.1 (SMBv3) protocol handles certain requests. An attacker who successfully exploited the vulnerability could gain the ability to execute code on the target server or client.

top.name: Adobe Reader and Acrobat Input Validation Vulnerability
top.description: Adobe Acrobat and Reader contain an input validation issue in a JavaScript method that could potentially lead to remote code execution.

top.name: PHP FastCGI Process Manager (FPM) Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
top.description: In some versions of PHP in certain configurations of FPM setup, it is possible to cause FPM module to write past allocated buffers allowing the possibility of remote code execution.

top.name: Adobe ColdFusion Directory Traversal Vulnerability
top.description: A directory traversal vulnerability exists in the administrator console in Adobe ColdFusion which allows remote attackers to read arbitrary files.

top.name: Apache Tomcat on Windows Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
top.description: When running Apache Tomcat on Windows with HTTP PUTs enabled, it is possible to upload a JSP file to the server via a specially crafted request. This JSP could then be requested and any code it contained would be executed by the server.

top.name: Webmin Command Injection Vulnerability
top.description: An issue was discovered in Webmin. The parameter old in password_change.cgi contains a command injection vulnerability.

top.name: Microsoft Windows SMBv1 Information Disclosure Vulnerability
top.description: The SMBv1 server in Microsoft Windows allows remote attackers to obtain sensitive information from process memory via a crafted packet.

top.name: Samba Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
top.description: Samba contains a remote code execution vulnerability, allowing a malicious client to upload a shared library to a writable share and then cause the server to load and execute it.

top.name: Microsoft SMBv1 Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
top.description: The SMBv1 server in Microsoft allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via crafted packets.

top.name: Microsoft SMBv1 Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
top.description: The SMBv1 server in multiple Microsoft Windows versions allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via crafted packets.

top.name: Drupal Core Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
top.description: A remote code execution vulnerability exists within multiple subsystems of Drupal that can allow attackers to exploit multiple attack vectors on a Drupal site.

top.product: Endpoint Manager Cloud Service Appliance (EPM CSA)
top.name: Ivanti Endpoint Manager Cloud Service Appliance (EPM CSA) Code Injection Vulnerability
top.description: Ivanti Endpoint Manager Cloud Service Appliance (EPM CSA) contains a code injection vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated user to execute malicious code with limited permissions (nobody).

top.name: Microsoft SQL Server Reporting Services Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
top.description: Microsoft SQL Server Reporting Services contains a deserialization vulnerability when handling page requests incorrectly. An authenticated attacker can exploit this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the Report Server service account.

top.name: Fortinet Multiple Products Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
top.description: Fortinet FortiOS, FortiProxy, and FortiSwitchManager contain an authentication bypass vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to perform operations on the administrative interface via specially crafted HTTP or HTTPS requests.

top.name: Oracle Java SE Unspecified Vulnerability
top.description: Unspecified vulnerability in the Java Runtime Environment (JRE) component in Oracle Java SE allows remote attackers to affect confidentiality, integrity, and availability via Unknown vectors related to 2D

top.name: Oracle Java SE Runtime Environment (JRE) Arbitrary Code Execution Vulnerability
top.description: The Java Runtime Environment (JRE) component in Oracle Java SE allow for remote code execution.

top.name: Oracle Java SE Runtime Environment (JRE) Arbitrary Code Execution Vulnerability
top.description: An incorrect type vulnerability exists in the Concurrency component of Oracle's Java Runtime Environment allows an attacker to remotely execute arbitrary code.

top.name: Rejetto HTTP File Server Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine Vulnerability
top.description: Rejetto HTTP File Server contains an improper neutralization of special elements used in a template engine vulnerability. This allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to execute commands on the affected system by sending a specially crafted HTTP request.

top.name: Sitecore XP Remote Command Execution Vulnerability
top.description: Sitcore XP contains an insecure deserialization vulnerability which can allow for remote code execution.

top.name: Oracle JRE Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
top.description: A vulnerability in the way Java restricts the permissions of Java applets could allow an attacker to execute commands on a vulnerable system.

top.name: VMware Tanzu Spring Data Commons Property Binder Vulnerability
top.description: Spring Data Commons contains a property binder vulnerability which can allow an attacker to perform remote code execution.

top.name: QNAP Photo Station Improper Access Control Vulnerability
top.description: QNAP NAS devices running Photo Station contain an improper access control vulnerability allowing remote attackers to gain unauthorized access to the system.

top.name: D-Link Multiple Routers OS Command Injection Vulnerability
top.description: Multiple D-Link routers contain an unspecified vulnerability that allows for execution of OS commands.

top.name: Atlassian Confluence Server and Data Center Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
top.description: Atlassian Confluence Server and Data Center contain a remote code execution vulnerability that allows for an unauthenticated attacker to perform remote code execution.

top.name: QNAP Photo Station Path Traversal Vulnerability
top.description: QNAP devices running Photo Station contain an external control of file name or path vulnerability allowing remote attackers to access or modify system files.

top.name: WinRAR Absolute Path Traversal Vulnerability
top.description: WinRAR Absolute Path Traversal vulnerability leads to Remote Code Execution
